name: conjugate_titer
description: Antibody titer measurements from conjugate-vaccine literature (pneumococcal, E. coli, GBS), keyed for later clustering by study batch, species and assay.
system_prompt: You are a meticulous document data-extraction agent working on vaccine immunogenicity literature. You extract ONLY facts explicitly stated in the provided material. You never guess, never infer unstated values, and you always quote your evidence verbatim. If a field is unknown, use null - null is always better than a plausible guess.
instructions:
Extract every explicitly reported antibody TITER or CONCENTRATION measurement and emit ONE JSON array.

ONE RECORD = one value, for one group, for one serotype, at one timepoint, from one assay.

Rules that matter most:
(A) NEVER merge OPA and IgG. They are different assays with different units and are never interchangeable. Set assay accordingly; if the text does not say which, use 'na' rather than guessing.
(B) NEVER pack serotype, species, dose or timepoint into group_label. Each gets its own field, so records can be grouped later.
(C) species is the animal or population actually assayed - infant/adult human, mouse, rabbit, or non-human primate. Record it even when it is only stated once in the methods.
(D) study_batch identifies the experiment the record came from: the study/trial name, lot, or experiment label as written. Records sharing a batch will be clustered together, so copy it exactly and consistently.
(E) NEGATIVE RESULTS ARE DATA AND MUST BE EXTRACTED. A vaccine that failed to raise a response is as informative as one that succeeded, and dropping such records silently biases everything computed from this table. Extract them as full records:
   - 'titer <1:8', '<0.05 ug/mL', 'below the limit of detection' -> value = the limit itself (0.05), censoring = 'left_censored', response_status = 'undetectable', detection_limit = the same limit.
   - 'the OPA titer was 1', 'did not elicit detectable antibodies', 'no response' -> value = that floor value (1), censoring = 'left_censored', response_status = 'undetectable', detection_limit = the same floor.
   - 'no significant rise from baseline', 'p = 0.42' -> censoring = 'observed', response_status = 'not_significant', with the reported value.
   - a value that is real but below a protective threshold (e.g. 0.20 against a 0.35 ug/mL threshold) -> censoring = 'observed', response_status = 'non_responder'.
   - an assay that was planned but never run, or a value simply absent -> response_status = 'not_measured', value = null. Never confuse this with a measured negative: 'not measured' and 'measured and found absent' are different facts.
(F) value IS THE MEASUREMENT, NEVER A COUNT OF SUBJECTS. In 'detectable titers were found in 28 (52%) of patients', 28 is n_subjects and 52 is a percentage of responders - neither is a titer. Put 28 in n_subjects, and only record a value if the titer itself is stated. If the sentence gives a proportion rather than a titer, set value to that proportion and value_kind = 'percent_responders'.
(G) value_unit is a UNIT, such as 'ug/mL', 'OPA titer' or '%'. It is never a sentence, a definition, or a phrase containing '='. If no unit is written, use null.
(H) censoring and response_status MUST be one of the listed enum values, exactly. Do not invent new ones. If none applies, use 'na'.
(I) value_source says where the number physically came from: running text, a table, or a figure. Be accurate - a figure reading is checked against the vision pass.
(J) Report the number exactly as printed, including its unit. Do not convert units.

fields.name: pathogen
fields.description: Organism the vaccine targets.

fields.name: assay
fields.description: Assay that produced the value. OPA and IgG must never be merged.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: Endpoint as written, e.g. 'GMT', 'GMC', 'OPA titer', 'IgG concentration'.

fields.name: serotype
fields.description: Serotype/serogroup exactly as written, e.g. '6B', '19A', 'III', 'O25b'. Null if not serotype-specific.

fields.name: species
fields.description: Species or population actually assayed.

fields.name: species_detail
fields.description: Strain or population as written, e.g. 'BALB/c', 'rhesus macaque', 'Japanese infants'.

fields.name: study_batch
fields.description: Study, trial, lot or experiment label as written. Used to cluster records from the same batch.

fields.name: group_label
fields.description: The single vaccine/control group this record describes. No serotype, dose, species or timepoint here.

fields.name: n_subjects
fields.description: Number of subjects or animals contributing to this value, else null.

fields.name: timepoint
fields.description: Timepoint as written, e.g. 'day 28', 'post-dose 3', 'pre-vaccination'.

fields.name: dose_number
fields.description: Which dose this follows, e.g. 'dose 2', 'booster', 'primary series'.

fields.name: dose_ug
fields.description: Antigen dose in micrograms, else null.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The reported number, exactly as printed.

fields.name: value_unit
fields.description: Unit exactly as written, e.g. 'ug/mL', 'OPA titer', 'ELISA units/mL'.

fields.name: value_kind
fields.description: What kind of summary the number is.

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower confidence bound if reported, else null.

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper confidence bound if reported, else null.

fields.name: censoring
fields.description: Whether the value is a detection-limit bound rather than a measurement. Use exactly one of the listed values.

fields.name: response_status
fields.description: The biological verdict, which is not the same question as censoring. 'undetectable' = assayed and nothing found; 'non_responder' = a real value that failed to reach the stated threshold; 'not_significant' = a rise that did not reach significance; 'responder' = met the threshold or rose significantly; 'not_measured' = never assayed, which is absence of data rather than a negative result.

fields.name: detection_limit
fields.description: The assay's stated limit of detection or quantification, in value_unit. Needed to rank censored values correctly instead of treating them as zero.

fields.name: response_threshold
fields.description: Protective or seroconversion threshold the study judged responders against, e.g. 0.35 for pneumococcal IgG.

fields.name: carrier
fields.description: Carrier protein as written.

fields.name: valency
fields.description: Vaccine valency if stated, e.g. 13 for PCV13.

fields.name: vaccine_name
fields.description: Vaccine product or candidate name as written, e.g. 'PCV13', 'V114', 'MAPS'.

fields.name: p_value
fields.description: p-value as written, e.g. '<0.001', else null.

fields.name: value_source
fields.description: Where the number physically came from.

fields.name: figure
fields.description: Figure or table label the value was read from, e.g. 'Figure 2A', 'Table 3'.

fields.name: extraction_mode
fields.description: How the record was obtained. Set by the pipeline, not the model: 'llm' = the text pass read it directly; 'ocr' = read from a figure or table image; 'multimodal' = the cheap passes could not resolve it alone and a stronger multi-input model was given the text, the figures and the tables together to work it out.

fields.name: escalation_reason
fields.description: Why the record needed the stronger multimodal model, e.g. 'table had no caption', 'value plotted but unlabelled', 'group named only in the body text'.

fields.name: modality_conflict
fields.description: Set by the pipeline when the text layer and the figure reading disagree about the same measurement.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Anything needed to interpret the record, including why a value is missing.

fields.name: review_status
fields.description: Set by the pipeline after validation. 'accepted' passed every check, on its own or after escalation; 'needs_review' still carries a contradiction the document could not resolve, and should be excluded from anything computed on the table until a human has looked.

fields.name: convergence_rounds
fields.description: How many escalation rounds this record needed. 0 means the cheap passes were enough.

fields.name: source_span
fields.description: REQUIRED verbatim quote (<=200 chars) from the document supporting this record.
